description: Make a professional sales receipt: add line items, tax and discount, see the total live, then download or print it.

faqs.a: Yes. Enter each sold item with quantity and price, set the tax rate, and the receipt shows itemized lines, subtotal, tax and grand total.
The download is a plain-text (.txt) receipt with clean monospace formatting, and the print button opens a print-ready page.
No — it is generated entirely in your browser and never leaves your device.
faqs.q: Is my business data uploaded anywhere?

faqs.a: Enter a negative-style discount as a percentage (0–100) in the discount field; it is subtracted after tax is added to the subtotal.

howto: Enter your business name and add receipt line items with quantity and price.
Set the tax rate and any discount percentage.
Download the .txt receipt or click Print receipt for a paper copy.
title: Receipt Maker
